relations.text: 資産と事業を2024年に買収
relations.text_en: Bought its assets and operations in 2024

source.label: Century Communities 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 31, 2024, we closed on the acquisition of substantially all the assets and operations and assumed certain liabilities of Anglia Homes LP ("Anglia"), a homebuilder with operations, including 26 active communities, in the greater Houston, Texas area, for approximately $127.0 million in cash, inclusive of customary holdbacks.
